guides.before_you_start: Keep your existing values for a read-only tour. Opening this guide does not activate a provider, start services or apply settings.

steps.title: Check recognition readiness
steps.body: Read Recognition for the installed faster-whisper backend state. Confirm the runtime’s speech-to-text is set to this backend and a working microphone is selected. This backend is local and English-optimized. Recognition settings report readiness; they do not start a recording, so a captured transcript is still required.
steps.target_hint: This control may depend on available content or a loaded addon. Read the step here; no service or provider is enabled by the guide.

steps.title: Confirm with a short captured phrase
steps.body: With push-to-talk or voice input ready, say a short harmless English phrase and check the recognized text. If nothing is transcribed, confirm the backend selection, microphone device and speech-to-text runtime before changing settings. Local recognition does not depend on a network sign-in.
